newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks firm at start, focus on results.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks firm at start, focus on results.

text.p: MADRID, July 14 (Reuter) 0830 GMT - Madrid shares were firm in early trade on Monday, against a backdrop of bond and peseta strength, dealers said.
Focus this week will be on first half results from the banks, with expectations of healthy growth expected to provide opportunities for more buying, dealers said.
* General index up 2.0 points, 0.32 percent, to 625.17
* Banesto, which may report results today, was up 10 pesetas to 1,505. First half profits are seen up 20.7 percent, according to a Reuters poll.
* Ten minute trading halt called at 1000 GMT in protest at the killing of a Basque official by separatist group ETA.
Asturiana del Zinc was up 9.12 percent to 3,290 after its trading suspension was lifted. Glencore last week requested to buy an additional 20 percent of Asturiana at an offer of 3,400 pesetas.

Dealers said the Ibex blue chip index may gain to around 7,200, where technical resistance is pegged. However if references from foreign markets are positive, buyers may see the Ibex break that level, they added.
